authorization: The user authorized killing the B550 embedding services for Strata work and asked to continue the Strata optimization for the B550.
scope: Find whether B550's asymmetric PCIe topology can be exploited for more decode/prompt throughput on the pinned Qwen IQ2_XS/Q2_0 MTP workload, with a contamination guard on every arm.
host: B550 alias 192.168.1.171, dual RTX 3090 Ti 24GB, kernel 7.0.0-38, custom open NVIDIA module 595.99.02 (build tag kearm@b550)

topology_facts.note: GPU0 is chipset-attached at Gen3 x4 while GPU1 is CPU-root Gen4 x16, an 8.7x host-bandwidth asymmetry. The engine's auto placement search already scales each stage's miss cost by its probed link.
topology_facts.pci_identifier_note: The identifiers are the values nvidia-smi reports as pci.bus_id on this host. Note the bus numbers are 04 and 08, not 00: the earlier note wrote 0000:00:04.0, which reads as a device on bus 00 and would select the wrong PCI device.

contamination_incident.what_happened: A first pass of these arms measured 50-73 tok/s, far below the 227 tok/s control, and the placement logs showed only 2.99 GiB free and 1628 cache slots instead of 20.04 GiB and 12288.
contamination_incident.root_cause: Another session's live job, a Ming ASR teacher transcription (tmux ming-full-none, /home/kearm/salm-lora/asr_teachers, started 16:33:50), held ~17.5 GB on each GPU (PIDs 68886 and 68888). The ~17,459 MiB difference in free VRAM (20.04 GiB expected against 2.99 GiB observed, 1024-based units) matches that footprint, to the precision the two-decimal GiB inputs allow.
contamination_incident.handling: The foreign job was NOT stopped or disturbed; it was allowed to finish (500/500 on both arms, hyps written) and then the arms were re-run on a clean GPU.
contamination_incident.lesson: A pre-flight guard that aborts when any foreign process holds GPU memory is now part of the arm script (clean_arms.sh); the guard printed 0,1 / 1,33 MiB before the clean run started.

clean_arms.workload: the pinned 25-token binary-search prompt, max_tokens 128, temperature 0, reasoning_effort none, one discarded warm-up plus 5 measured requests, identical model/pack/MTP runtime/engine binary (SHA-256 c10370e122a26752d7dbfa4802a4ff861f84c5806b54de95cdbb2b1ed86bfdf8) and remote revision 83f67c4fff7262ec4af6000f3e7d973db5f21dc0

reverse_order_control_last.purpose: rule out a warm-page-cache artifact: the control arm runs last, so the file cache is already warm for it

controlb.prefill: 12288 of 12288 in 6.1 s (2816 MB/s), still cold

result.winner: explicit --layer-split 30 with the fast CPU-root card first (--gpu 1,0)
result.decode_gain_vs_control: +4.01% (forward order, 236.0 vs 226.9) and +7.16% (reverse order, 243.6 vs 227.3); control is stable at 226.9-227.3 across both orderings
result.artifact_ruled_out: The gain is not a warm-cache artifact: with the control running last its expert prefill was still 6.1 s (cold) and its decode stayed at 227.3, while split30 measured 243.6 in the same ordering.
result.mechanism_hypothesis: Giving the Gen4 x16 card 30 of 48 layers moves layer work and the expert-miss stream onto the fast link; the split also changes the per-card cache sizing (14499 slots, 599 MiB free) and the draft window (67-68 of 79-80 accepted versus 66 of 78). This is a hypothesis consistent with the probed links, not an isolated causal proof.
negative_results: Reversing the card order alone (auto placement) changes little: +1.06% decode, because the auto search already scales miss cost by the probed link and still reaches K=24 with 100% residency.
STRATA_SPLIT_MISS_MS at 600 and 2000 leaves the placement decision unchanged (K=24, 12288 slots) and the throughput within 0.2% of control, so the miss-cost constant is not a live lever on this rig.
An earlier contaminated pass had suggested reversed order and explicit split 30 were 3-4x slower; that was the foreign Ming ASR job, not the configurations.

non_claims: Five measured requests per arm on one short coding prompt; not a broad or long-context matrix, and the arms are not interleaved (each arm is a separate engine start).
The decode gain is measured, but the mechanism (link asymmetry versus cache sizing versus draft window) is a hypothesis: no arm isolated those factors.
No long-context, batch, multi-client, or quality comparison was run for the split-30 configuration.
The split-30 configuration was measured on this model and this engine revision; it is not established for other models or cards.
No change was made to any deployed configuration: the finding is a recommendation with evidence, not an applied default.
The contamination incident and the foreign job are recorded because they changed what could be measured; the foreign job's own results are not evaluated here.
